args: Session-tracking coverage vs order volume for top merchants, 2025

Does the >100% visit-to-cart ratio in the Q4 funnel reflect real shopper behavior, or is web-session tracking sparse relative to order volume for certain merchants (e.g. subscription sellers), making 'visits' an unreliable denominator for them?
